calibration.calibration: Unlabeled tracking only; missingness does not identify true occlusion causes
calibration.coordinate_errors: Assumed ranges; no coordinate ground truth available

recipe.ball_gap: alternating observed/gap runs; empirical duration histogram, capped at 30 s
recipe.scope: All applied before features; timestamps, frame grid and labels unchanged; no cross-block interpolation

spec.training: One clean and one deterministic corrupted copy, each half the training mass; same model capacities and eight GRU epochs
spec.baseline: Exact packaged baseline for pooled; original clean+slot-dropout D protocol refit for each D provider holdout
spec.team_training: Unchanged multisource HGB fit/4 Hz/team-swap; replaces original ball-gap copy with composite corruption
spec.D_training: Unchanged learned_temporal models, normalization, 5 Hz, provider/match weights; replaces slot-dropout copy
spec.evaluation: Labels/graded masks fixed from original views even after synthetic player loss; identical frame grids in all arms
spec.holdout_scope: D heads only; both team models remain pooled and have seen training matches from all providers
spec.ranking: Official spell F1, exact-tie macro F1; clean and corrupted reported separately; no automatic promotion
spec.corruption_replicates: Two fixed seeds per match; average seeds within each match before equal-provider means
spec.decision: Retain adopted baseline pending external results and independent confirmation
